title: Prime-density hierarchy for Bertrand, BHP, and Cramer

problemStatement.formal: bertrand_density_lower_bound gives Nat.primeCounting n >= Nat.log 2 n for n >= 2; the matched family also records ShortIntervalPNT and Cramer-to-PrimeGapConjecture conditionals.
problemStatement.plain: Formalize the short-interval prime hierarchy from Bertrand through BHP, PNT-density statements, and conditional Cramer consequences.
whyMatters: Connects Bertrand's classical result to modern short-interval prime density bounds
Gives a concrete logarithmic lower bound via iterated Bertrand doubling
Documents the frontier from BHP exponent 0.525 to Cramer-style logarithmic gaps

proven: bertrand_iterated: primeCounting (2^k * n) >= primeCounting n + k for n >= 1
bertrand_density_lower_bound: primeCounting n >= Nat.log 2 n for n >= 2
shortIntervalPNT_implies_primeGapConjecture_eventually and cramer_implies_primeGapConjecture record stronger conditional results
open: cramer_conjecture: max gap near p_n is O((log p_n)^2), axiomatized
shortIntervalPNT_rh_conditional: RH/von-Koch style density input, axiomatized
